context.content: Ours doesn't change too much but we also change ours every couple of years. This one is called the 4.0 because it's the 4th eID we have. The biggest drama was with the new pictures becuase they need to be biometric and you can now take them at the police for free so photographs will lose money. Imho this new design isn't great. The new photos have even more light/darkness problems and are taken by a cop (aka you are even uglier) and your digital certificates still only last one year (seriously, am I the only one that always has then expire on me when I need them???).
